observationsToCarryForward: systemctl NRestarts read 0 for every interrupted trial because it was sampled after the unit became inactive; the journal shows 'Scheduled restart job, restart counter is at 1' for each. The run of record counts journal restarts per trial.
t5-I2: b's worker invoked the responder 97 ms before the I2 fault exited the process; after restart it re-invoked once and committed one result. This is the declared at-least-once behaviour.

t7: the specialisation switch took 41.3 s and restarted b's contract (InvocationID changed; IPAddressAllow 192.168.1.10/32 -> 192.168.1.40/32). The held connection then failed with BrokenPipe; a new connection from a timed out before TLS; a's control connection to b still connected. The held-connection outcome cannot separate the restart from the filter.
Guests kept eth0's QEMU user-network link route (10.0.2.0/24) after the default route was removed; ip_unprivileged_port_start was 1024 on all three guests.
